instruction:
You are a wastewater process engineer checking a task-owned synthetic SSC-10 wet-weather process and bypass resilience package.

Use only the task-owned synthetic source pack values shown below for numeric grading. Wet-weather process, storage, pump backup energy, control rules, and bypass-permit workflows shape the context only; this instance does not parse a real hydraulic model, permit file, or accepted project report.

## Scene

- Product: `SSC-10-LH-06`
- Wet-weather inflow table: `WET-10-INFLOW-06`
- Process unit schedule: `UNIT-10-SCHED-06`
- Pump/storage schedule: `PUMP-10-STORAGE-06`
- Control rules: `CONTROL-10-RULES-06`
- Permit criterion: `PERMIT-10-BYPASS-06`
- Wet-weather memo: `MEMO-10-WET-06`

## Source Values

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Peak inflow | {{ peak_inflow_m3_h }} m3/h |
| Process capacity | {{ process_capacity_m3_h }} m3/h |
| Peak duration | {{ peak_duration_h }} h |
| Reactor volume | {{ reactor_volume_m3 }} m3 |
| Minimum HRT | {{ min_hrt_hr }} h |
| Clarifier area | {{ clarifier_area_m2 }} m2 |
| Maximum peak SOR | {{ max_peak_sor_m3_m2_d }} m3/m2/d |
| Available storage | {{ available_storage_m3 }} m3 |
| Pump head | {{ pump_head_m }} m |
| Pump efficiency | {{ pump_efficiency }} |
| Pump motor efficiency | {{ pump_motor_efficiency }} |
| Backup BESS | {{ backup_bess_kwh }} kWh |
| BESS usable SOC | {{ bess_usable_soc_fraction }} |
| BESS inverter efficiency | {{ bess_inverter_efficiency }} |
| BESS reserve | {{ bess_reserve_kwh }} kWh |
| Outage duration | {{ outage_duration_h }} h |
| Allowed bypass | {{ allowed_bypass_m3 }} m3 |

## Calculation Rules

- Required storage equals excess wet-weather flow times peak duration.
- Reactor HRT equals reactor volume divided by peak inflow.
- Clarifier peak SOR equals peak inflow times 24 divided by clarifier area.
- Pump input power uses water density, gravity, flow, pump head, pump efficiency, and motor efficiency.
- Usable backup energy equals BESS capacity times usable SOC times inverter efficiency minus reserve.
- Bypass volume equals any excess flow that remains after process capacity and storage are exhausted.
- Overall pass score is `1.0` only when storage, HRT, SOR, backup-energy, and bypass margins are non-negative.

## Output Format

Write a compact memo to `/workspace/output.md`. Include a source-boundary statement that this is a task-owned synthetic source pack. Preserve the source IDs above and state whether the baseline source pack passes the current docs-only checks.

Do not claim authority approval, accepted project evidence, software export validity, full standards compliance, executable real source-pack parsing, generated modelling evidence, generated benchmark readiness, or benchmark readiness.

Include a fenced JSON block with exactly these numeric keys:

```json
{
  "required_storage_m3": <numeric_value>,
  "storage_margin_m3": <numeric_value>,
  "reactor_hrt_hr": <numeric_value>,
  "hrt_margin_hr": <numeric_value>,
  "clarifier_peak_sor_m3_m2_d": <numeric_value>,
  "sor_margin_m3_m2_d": <numeric_value>,
  "pump_input_power_kw": <numeric_value>,
  "outage_energy_kwh": <numeric_value>,
  "usable_backup_energy_kwh": <numeric_value>,
  "backup_energy_margin_kwh": <numeric_value>,
  "bypass_volume_m3": <numeric_value>,
  "bypass_margin_m3": <numeric_value>,
  "overall_pass_score": <numeric_value>
}
```

# ABOUTME: Defines the SSC-10 wet-weather process and bypass resilience template.
# ABOUTME: Pins one wet-weather inflow, unit, pump/storage, control, permit, and memo source pack.

[meta]
name = "wet-weather-process-bypass-resilience-package"
description = "SSC-10 wet-weather process and bypass resilience metrics"
long_description = "Calculates source-bound wet-weather resilience metrics from a deterministic SSC-10 task-owned source pack. The template combines storage need, reactor HRT, clarifier peak SOR, pump energy, backup energy, bypass volume, and an overall synthetic pass score."
discipline = "mechanical"
category = "wet-weather-bypass-resilience"
standards = ["wet-weather process workflow", "bypass resilience workflow", "pump backup energy workflow"]
tags = ["mechanical", "wastewater", "wet-weather", "bypass", "storage", "pump", "backup-energy", "deterministic"]
tool_mode = "with-tool"

[params.peak_inflow_m3_h]
type = "float"
unit = "m3/h"
description = "WET-10-INFLOW-06 peak wet-weather inflow"
min = 1120.0
max = 1120.0

[params.process_capacity_m3_h]
type = "float"
unit = "m3/h"
description = "UNIT-10-SCHED-06 process capacity"
min = 820.0
max = 820.0

[params.peak_duration_h]
type = "float"
unit = "h"
description = "WET-10-INFLOW-06 peak duration"
min = 3.5
max = 3.5

[params.reactor_volume_m3]
type = "float"
unit = "m3"
description = "UNIT-10-SCHED-06 reactor volume"
min = 3600.0
max = 3600.0

[params.min_hrt_hr]
type = "float"
unit = "h"
description = "PERMIT-10-BYPASS-06 minimum HRT"
min = 3.2
max = 3.2

[params.clarifier_area_m2]
type = "float"
unit = "m2"
description = "UNIT-10-SCHED-06 clarifier area"
min = 520.0
max = 520.0

[params.max_peak_sor_m3_m2_d]
type = "float"
unit = "m3/m2/d"
description = "PERMIT-10-BYPASS-06 maximum peak SOR"
min = 58.0
max = 58.0

[params.available_storage_m3]
type = "float"
unit = "m3"
description = "PUMP-10-STORAGE-06 available storage"
min = 1100.0
max = 1100.0

[params.pump_head_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "PUMP-10-STORAGE-06 pump head"
min = 14.0
max = 14.0

[params.pump_efficiency]
type = "float"
description = "PUMP-10-STORAGE-06 pump efficiency"
min = 0.72
max = 0.72

[params.pump_motor_efficiency]
type = "float"
description = "PUMP-10-STORAGE-06 motor efficiency"
min = 0.93
max = 0.93

[params.backup_bess_kwh]
type = "float"
unit = "kWh"
description = "CONTROL-10-RULES-06 backup BESS capacity"
min = 320.0
max = 320.0

[params.bess_usable_soc_fraction]
type = "float"
description = "CONTROL-10-RULES-06 usable BESS SOC"
min = 0.86
max = 0.86

[params.bess_inverter_efficiency]
type = "float"
description = "CONTROL-10-RULES-06 BESS inverter efficiency"
min = 0.93
max = 0.93

[params.bess_reserve_kwh]
type = "float"
unit = "kWh"
description = "CONTROL-10-RULES-06 BESS reserve"
min = 35.0
max = 35.0

[params.outage_duration_h]
type = "float"
unit = "h"
description = "CONTROL-10-RULES-06 backup operation duration"
min = 2.5
max = 2.5

[params.allowed_bypass_m3]
type = "float"
unit = "m3"
description = "PERMIT-10-BYPASS-06 allowed bypass volume"
min = 0.0
max = 0.0

[outputs.required_storage_m3]
description = "Storage required for excess wet-weather flow"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.storage_margin_m3]
description = "Available storage minus required storage"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.reactor_hrt_hr]
description = "Wet-weather reactor HRT"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.hrt_margin_hr]
description = "Reactor HRT minus minimum HRT"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.clarifier_peak_sor_m3_m2_d]
description = "Clarifier peak SOR"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.sor_margin_m3_m2_d]
description = "Peak SOR limit minus calculated SOR"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.pump_input_power_kw]
description = "Pump input power"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.outage_energy_kwh]
description = "Pump outage energy"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.usable_backup_energy_kwh]
description = "Usable backup energy"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.backup_energy_margin_kwh]
description = "Usable backup energy minus outage energy"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.bypass_volume_m3]
description = "Calculated bypass volume"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.bypass_margin_m3]
description = "Allowed bypass minus calculated bypass"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.overall_pass_score]
description = "1.0 when storage, HRT, SOR, backup, and bypass margins are non-negative"
tolerance = 0.001
